stress_tests: NEGATIVE_PO_AGE: set PO-to-invoice interval to minus 7 days, holding all gate inputs fixed
COHERENT_VALUE_SUBSTITUTION: multiply observed PO, invoice and GR values by 10 and recompute ratios, holding exposure fixed as an external evaluation variable
stress_scope: natural held-out states; paired originals; fixed gate and already-trained mismatch models; not production harm labels
censoring_scope: maturity restrictions under original D1, not fixed-horizon outcome relabeling
new_selection: split original natural calibration source cases deterministically into isotonic fitting and threshold selection halves; train models on original train cases
risk_control: Learn then Test style one-sided exact binomial tests with Bonferroni correction over 25 fixed thresholds, delta=0.05; natural source-case UER; exchangeability guarantee limited to IID assumptions
crc: monotone unsafe-execution indicator per natural case, not conditional UER; finite sample correction (n*empirical_loss+1)/(n+1)
gather: original GATHER results retrospective only; prospective analyses disable GATHER; no use of t1 score at t0
public_release: prepare local reproducibility materials; no external publishing
